description: This file defines FastAPI dependencies related to authentication and authorization, including functions to retrieve current user claims from tokens, with support for multiple fallback methods, and role-based access control mechanisms.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_current_user(request: Request, token: Optional[str] = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Retrieves the current user's claims from a Bearer token, supporting multiple header sources including Authorization, X-Auth-Token, and query parameters.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_current_user_strict(request: Request, token: Optional[str] = Depends(oauth2_scheme))
methods.description: Retrieves user claims strictly from headers (Authorization and X-Auth-Token) without query param fallback.

methods.name: Callable[[Dict[str,Any]],Dict[str,Any]] role_required(allowed_roles: List[str])
methods.description: Returns a dependency function that enforces role-based access control, accepting a list of allowed roles.

methods.name: Callable[[Dict[str,Any]],Dict[str,Any]] role_required_strict(allowed_roles: List[str])
methods.description: Strict variant of role_required that uses only header-based token retrieval for sensitive routes.
